scope: Plett Road geology, Wellogic, topographic, groundwater-flow and Clam River flow evidence intake

wellSubsetValidation.resolution: Retained as a convenient derived subset of the official county Wellogic package. It does not replace certified well records or supply the coordinated elevations and measurements needed for a local groundwater-flow determination.

clamRiverValidation.stationName: CLAM RIVER AT PLETT ROAD AT CADILLAC, MI
clamRiverValidation.resolution: Retained as official surface-water hydrology context. The ten field visits are not a continuous series and do not establish groundwater gradient, PFAS conditions or source-to-receptor transport.

queueResolution.reason: The five repeated files add no new evidence. The two distinct files provide a derived nearby-well subset and sparse surface-water discharge context, but neither supplies a certified Plett well record, coordinated local water levels, a site-specific groundwater-flow map, PFAS analytical results or source-to-receptor sampling.

integrityNotes: All seven supplied files were SHA-256 hashed and compared against every current catalog record.
The two ZIP archives opened successfully; every member was read and the USGS CSV tables parsed without an unreadable row.
